queries.queryString:
_sourceCategory={{Logsdatasource}}   Workload   SourceRelativeUrl SourceFileName
| parse "\"Workload\":\"*\"" as workLoad
| parse "\"SourceRelativeUrl\":\"*\"" as SourceRelativeUrl
| parse "\"SourceFileName\":\"*\"" as sourcefilename
| where workLoad in ("SharePoint", "OneDrive")
|where if ("{{sourcefilename}}" = "*", true, sourcefilename matches "{{sourcefilename}}") AND if ("{{sourcerelativeurl}}" = "*", true, sourcerelativeurl matches "{{sourcerelativeurl}}")
|count by SourceRelativeUrl, sourcefilename
| urldecode(SourceRelativeUrl)
| order by _count | limit 50

_sourceCategory={{Logsdatasource}}   Workload SiteUrl 
| parse "\"Workload\":\"*\"" as workLoad
| parse "\"SiteUrl\":\"*\"" as siteUrl
| where workLoad in ("SharePoint", "OneDrive")
|where if ("{{siteurl}}" = "*", true, siteurl matches "{{siteurl}}")
|count siteUrl 
| urldecode(siteUrl)
| top 10 siteUrl by _count

_sourceCategory={{Logsdatasource}}   Workload ItemType File  SourceFileExtension
| parse "\"Workload\":\"*\"" as workLoad
| parse "\"SourceFileExtension\":\"*\"" as filetype
| parse "\"ItemType\":\"*\"" as itemtype
| where workLoad in ("SharePoint", "OneDrive") and itemtype="File"
| tolowercase(filetype) as filetype 
|count by filetype | sort by _count, filetype

_sourceCategory={{Logsdatasource}}   Workload  Operation (FileViewed or FileAccessed)
| parse "\"UserId\":\"*\"" as userId
| parse "\"Workload\":\"*\"" as workLoad
| parse "\"Operation\":\"*\"" as operation
| parse "\"SourceFileName\":\"*\"" as SourceFileName
| parse "\"SourceRelativeUrl\":\"*\"" as SourceRelativeUrl
| where workLoad in ("SharePoint", "OneDrive") and operation in ("FileViewed", "FileAccessed") and userId<>"SHAREPOINT\\\\system" and !(SourceRelativeUrl matches "Style Library/*" or SourceRelativeUrl matches "sites/*" or SourceRelativeUrl matches	"teams/*")
|where if ("{{userid}}" = "*", true, userid matches "{{userid}}") AND if ("{{operation}}" = "*", true, operation matches "{{operation}}") AND if ("{{sourcefilename}}" = "*", true, sourcefilename matches "{{sourcefilename}}") AND if ("{{sourcerelativeurl}}" = "*", true, sourcerelativeurl matches "{{sourcerelativeurl}}")
|count as Frequency by SourceRelativeUrl, SourceFileName 
| top 10 SourceRelativeUrl, SourceFileName by Frequency

panels.title: Content Checked In and Out Recently

queries.queryString:
_sourceCategory={{Logsdatasource}}   Workload  (FileCheckedOut or FileCheckedIn)
| parse "\"UserId\":\"*\"" as userId
| parse "\"Workload\":\"*\"" as workLoad
| parse "\"Operation\":\"*\"" as operation
| parse "\"SourceFileName\":\"*\"" as SourceFileName
| parse "\"SourceRelativeUrl\":\"*\"" as SourceRelativeUrl
| where workLoad in ("SharePoint", "OneDrive") and operation in ("FileCheckedOut", "FileCheckedIn")
|where if ("{{userid}}" = "*", true, userid matches "{{userid}}") AND if ("{{operation}}" = "*", true, operation matches "{{operation}}") AND if ("{{sourcefilename}}" = "*", true, sourcefilename matches "{{sourcefilename}}") AND if ("{{sourcerelativeurl}}" = "*", true, sourcerelativeurl matches "{{sourcerelativeurl}}")
|count by SourceRelativeUrl, SourceFileName | fields -_count
| urldecode(SourceRelativeUrl)
| sort by SourceRelativeUrl asc, SourceFileName asc

_sourceCategory={{Logsdatasource}}   Workload  operation FileUploaded
| parse "\"UserId\":\"*\"" as userId
| parse "\"Workload\":\"*\"" as workLoad
| parse "\"Operation\":\"*\"" as operation
| parse "\"SourceFileName\":\"*\"" as SourceFileName
| parse "\"SourceRelativeUrl\":\"*\"" as SourceRelativeUrl
| where workLoad in ("SharePoint", "OneDrive") and operation="FileUploaded"
|where if ("{{userid}}" = "*", true, userid matches "{{userid}}") AND if ("{{operation}}" = "*", true, operation matches "{{operation}}") AND if ("{{sourcefilename}}" = "*", true, sourcefilename matches "{{sourcefilename}}") AND if ("{{sourcerelativeurl}}" = "*", true, sourcerelativeurl matches "{{sourcerelativeurl}}")
|count as Frequency by SourceRelativeUrl, SourceFileName, userId | fields -Frequency

_sourceCategory={{Logsdatasource}}   Workload Operation FileDownloaded  UserId

| parse "\"Workload\":\"*\"" as workLoad
| parse "\"Operation\":\"*\"" as operation
| parse "\"SourceFileName\":\"*\"" as SourceFileName

|count as Frequency by SourceRelativeUrl, SourceFileName
| top 30 SourceRelativeUrl, SourceFileName by Frequency
